# Board of Certification for Emergency Nursing (BCEN)

> BCEN is the premier certifying body for emergency and trauma nursing specializations, offering six distinct credentials and comprehensive exam preparation resources.

BCEN provides professional certification and continuing education for emergency nurses across multiple specializations including trauma, pediatric, flight, transport, and burn nursing. The organization offers online learning platforms, review courses, and annual conferences to support nurse certification and career advancement.

## Key Topics

- Certified Emergency Nurse (CEN)
- Trauma Certified Registered Nurse (TCRN)
- Certified Pediatric Emergency Nurse (CPEN)
- Certified Flight Registered Nurse (CFRN)
- Certified Transport Registered Nurse (CTRN)
- Certified Burn Registered Nurse (CBRN)
- Emergency nursing certification
- Exam preparation and study resources
- Continuing education (CE) credits
- Certification verification
- Recertification and renewal
- Professional development
- BCEN Learn platform
- BCEN Learn Live conference

## Core Certifications

- [CEN - Certified Emergency Nurse Specialization](https://bcen.org/cen): Certified Emergency Nurse (CEN) certification details and exam preparation.
- [TCRN - Trauma Certified Registered Nurse Certification](https://bcen.org/tcrn): Trauma Certified Registered Nurse (TCRN) certification and exam prep.
- [CPEN - Certified Pediatric Emergency Nurse Certification](https://bcen.org/cpen): Certified Pediatric Emergency Nurse (CPEN) certification details.
- [CFRN - Certified Flight Registered Nurse Certification](https://bcen.org/cfrn): Certified Flight Registered Nurse (CFRN) certification information.
- [CTRN - Certified Transport Registered Nurse Certification](https://bcen.org/ctrn): Certified Transport Registered Nurse (CTRN) certification information.
- [CBRN - Certified Burn Registered Nurse](https://bcen.org/cbrn): Certified Burn Registered Nurse (CBRN) certification details.

## Exam Preparation & Learning Resources

- [BCEN Learn - Earn Nursing CEs Online](https://bcen.org/learn): BCEN Learn platform for online CE courses and practice exams.
- [CEN Review Course: Essentials of Emergency Nursing](https://bcen.org/cen-review-course): Online CEN review course with study guide and practice questions.
- [CPEN Review Course: Essentials of Pediatric Emergency Nursing](https://bcen.org/cpen-review-course): Online CPEN review course for pediatric emergency nurse certification.
- [TCRN Review Course: Essentials of Trauma Nursing](https://bcen.org/tcrn-review-course): Online TCRN review course for trauma nursing certification exam.
- [BCEN's Emergency Nursing Conference: Learn Live](https://bcen.org/bcen-learn-live): Annual emergency nursing conference with CE credits and networking.

## Certification Management

- [How to Renew Your CEN, CFRN, CPEN, CTRN, TCRN or CBRN](https://bcen.org/recertify): Certification renewal and recertification paths for all BCEN credentials.
- [BCEN Certification Verification](https://bcen.org/verify-certification): Primary-source certification verification for employers and job seekers.
- [Retired Designation - BCEN](https://bcen.org/retired-designation): Retired designation application process for BCEN credential holders.

## Support & Resources

- [Students - BCEN](https://bcen.org/students): Student resources for emergency nursing certification preparation.
- [The Board of Certification for Emergency Nursing | BCEN](https://bcen.org): BCEN homepage showcasing emergency nursing certifications and career advancement.
